gloss: mama bike; utility bicycle with a basket

definitions.gloss: mama bike; utility bicycle (with basket and child seat)
definitions.explanation: A practical city bicycle with a low frame, a front basket, and often one or two child seats. The default bike type for everyday shopping, school runs, and short errands in Japan.

examples.japanese: ママチャリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'll go shopping on the mama-bike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かご⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ついたママチャリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a mama-bike with baskets in front and back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え→送り迎え：14362_okurimukae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧⟦アシスト→アシスト：29696_ashisuto⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ママチャリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: For dropping off and picking up at daycare, an electric-assist mama-bike is very convenient.

notes:
Casual compound of ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧ (mom) + ⟦チャリ→チャリ：27535_chari⟧ (bike, slang for ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧). Despite the name, used by anyone — students, men, grandparents — not only mothers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧ママチャリ: electric-assist mama-bike
- ママチャリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a mama-bike
- ママチャリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え→送り迎え：14362_okurimukae⟧: to do school / daycare runs by mama-bike
- ママチャリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}かご: the front basket of a mama-bike

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ママチャリ is a Japanese icon: cheap, sturdy, three-speed at most, and built for short flat-city trips. Common features include a frame low enough to step through in a skirt, a basket large enough for grocery bags, a wheel lock, and front/rear child seats. Distinguishes itself sharply from sports bikes (ロード⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧) and folding bikes (⟦{折|お}り{畳|たた}み→折り畳む：12803_oritatamu⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧).
